question: Who is included among the six types of assailants identified here?
premises: One who seizes fields or wives is named.
A group of six is indicated.
inference: The seizer of fields or wives is counted among the six assailants.
uncertainties: Only one category is explicitly named in this verse; the other five are implied from context.
plain_english: And the seizer of fields and wives—these six are assailants, thus.
